why: Multiple post-snapshot papers report improvements to the halving-lines bounds: a 2024 Symmetry paper improving the additive constant in the asymptotic upper bound, and a January 2025 paper improving lower bounds for the maximum number of halving lines (and rectilinear crossing number) for planar sets with 35, 59, 95, and 97 points.
queries: k-set problem halving lines upper bound improved 2025
k-set problem discrete geometry solved arXiv 2025

found.title: An Improvement of the Upper Bound for the Number of Halving Lines of Planar Sets
found.note: Improves the additive constant in the asymptotic upper bound for the maximum number of halving lines for even n.

found.title: An Improvement of the Lower Bound on the Maximum Number of Halving Lines for Sets in the Plane with an Odd Number of Points
found.note: Improves lower bounds on halving lines for specific point sets (35, 59, 95, 97 points), also affecting rectilinear crossing number bounds.
